title: Compact Rollout Lane Editor and Quick Snapback Prototype
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a compact, lane-oriented rollout editor focused on fast authoring and an express 'snapback' rollback action for urgent incidents. The design should: 1) expose a minimal set of controls for quick canary and A/B traffic splits (percentage sliders, predefined presets), 2) show a condensed timeline with live simulation timebox (15s–2m) so engineers can validate latency/cost overlays, 3) include a one-click emergency snapback that reverts traffic to the last known stable lane while preserving rollout metadata for postmortem and re-deploy, and 4) fit in a small panel in the Console's top-right so PMs can triage without navigating to full release composer. This ticket contains the interactive Figma prototype, simulation constraints, accessibility notes, and handoff tokens for engineering.
